description: Bitwise CRC-32 (reflected), polynomial 0xEDB88320, init 0xFFFFFFFF, final XOR 0xFFFFFFFF.
validation_note: Matches zlib.crc32 and the published check value for '123456789' (already verified in v1).

description: Same polynomial/init as CRC-32, no final inversion.
validation_note: Matches the published check value for '123456789' given in V2_SPEC.md section 5.2; also equals 0xFFFFFFFF ^ crc32('123456789').

description: CRC-32 with the Castagnoli polynomial 0x82F63B78 instead of 0xEDB88320.
validation_note: Matches the published check value for '123456789' given in V2_SPEC.md section 5.2.
Matches zlib.adler32 and the published check value for 'Wikipedia' (already verified in v1).

description: 16-bit-word running sums mod 0xFFFF, combined as (s2<<16)|s1; odd-length input zero-padded.
validation_note: Matches the published Fletcher-32 check values for 'abcde' (0xF04FC729) and 'abcdefgh' (0xEBE19591) from Wikipedia's Fletcher's checksum article, found and cross-checked 2026-10-29.

description: FNV-1a 32-bit: xor byte in, then multiply by the FNV prime.
validation_note: Matches the published FNV-1a32('a') check value (already verified in v1).

description: FNV-1 32-bit: multiply by the FNV prime first, then xor the byte in (opposite order from FNV-1a). Shares both constants with FNV-1a.
validation_note: Matches the published FNV-1_32('a') check value given in V2_SPEC.md section 5.2.
Already validated in v1 against an independent Python implementation on 7 inputs.

Algorithm cross-checked against a published MurmurHash3 x86_32 test vector set (seed 0x9747b28c, not 0): 'aaa'->0x283E0130, 'aaaa'->0x5A97808A, 'Hello, world!'->0x24884CBA, all 3/3 exact matches, confirming the core algorithm; seed=0 itself only trivially changes h1's initial value, found 2026-10-29.

Matches the published Jenkins one-at-a-time check values for 'a' (0xca2e9442) and 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog' (0x519e91f5) from Wikipedia's Jenkins hash function article, found and cross-checked 2026-10-29.
